title: Classical limits and learning gaps for compound bosonic fading channels
artifact_status: Unpublished proposed v3 of same record

importance.scale: AIRR high-ceiling 0-10 supplied in airr-scale.txt; publication baseline 3, very good 5, excellent 6, exceptional 7, field-changing 8
importance.reason: Substantial specialist quantitative synthesis and plausible new Gaussian-hull/marginal consequences; established minimax/training tools and an implicit unquantified learning example limit broader significance.

technical_quality.scale: Separate technical-quality 0-10 judgment, not AIRR importance or probability of correctness
technical_quality.reason: Complete source/PDF proof audit found no material mathematical blocker; quantifiers, common decoders, heavy-tail continuity, energy accounting and quantum mutual-information finiteness are treated carefully.

correctness_confidence.reason: Substantive arguments checked; no located counterexample, but no formal verification or independent replication.

rigor.reason: Energy, quantifiers, compactness, decoder universality and finiteness explicit.

novelty.reason: Plausible new quantitative combination and Gaussian restriction results using established ingredients; no exhaustive priority certification.

significance.reason: Specialist value under narrow scaling; strict gap is existential and uncomputed.

reproducibility.reason: Frozen source and explicit proofs; no numerical gap or threshold calculation.

recommendation: Accept with minor clarifications for a specialist venue, subject to ordinary independent editorial review.
adverse_significance_findings: General compound minimax order, finite-family feedback training and strict finite compound gaps have primary antecedents; Section 7 is not a new general resource principle.
The learning pair has an AWGN gain defined implicitly through an uncomputed reset capacity; neither its positive gap nor useful finite-energy threshold is evaluated.
The uniform classical limit assumes fixed bounded gain and positive normalized-noise floor in a simultaneous signal/noise scaling.
Typical independent Gaussian-book restrictions do not establish arbitrary Gaussian-protocol optimality or decoder achievability.

recommended_minor_clarifications.action: Write 0 <= K < infinity explicitly; nonempty Gamma already entails nonnegativity.
Replace ambiguous lower-channel wording by channel used for the lower bound or W-plus.
Give Boche et al. PDF Theorem 1 / HTML Theorem 3.1 locators together.

optional_development: An evaluated positive gap/threshold and physically motivated fading family would increase usefulness; not required for the stated existence theorem.
